svg.text: I write mostly Python. Computer vision with OpenCV (Canny edges, frame
by frame target tracking), small CLI tools, and bits of automation I try
to keep tested with pytest. This page is one of them: it pulls the
GitHub API and draws its own SVGs with plain SMIL, no JavaScript. Lately
also some reverse engineering, reading a vendor's Windows tool so my
keyboard works on Linux. I try to check what I build against ground
truth or a zero shot baseline like SAM 2 or DBSCAN, mostly because I do
not trust my own results until something else agrees with them. Still
learning a lot of this as I go.
